summary: Files Sharing is a self-hosted application designed for transferring files via unique and temporary URLs. It provides a straightforward interface for single-click and drag-and-drop uploads, allowing you to generate downloadable links without relying on third-party cloud services.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams who need a dedicated, lightweight tool to quickly send files to clients or colleagues through private links.
watchOut: Development activity is currently slowing down, and the project overlaps heavily with more mature file-sharing and cloud storage alternatives.
deployNotes: Because it relies on PHP and Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for uploaded files and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
